subject: general
question: N women can complete the project in 12 days. If 5 women are less employed then it will take 15 more days to complete the same project, then find the number of women initially employed.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

N women can complete the project in T days. 

If M women are less employed then it will take d more days to complete the same project, 

Then the number of women initially employed = N = (M times (T + d))/(d)

According to the question, 

The initial number of women = N

The time is taken by N women to complete the task,T = 12 days

The number of women removed from the project, M = 5

The additional number of days required, d = 15 days

Now,

⇒ N = (5 times (12 + 15))/(15) = 9

∴ The initial number of women employed is 9.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** 

In the first case:

N women can complete the project in 12 days.

In the second case:

If 5 women are less employed then it will take 15 more days to complete the same project.

**Formula used:**

M1D1 = M2D2 

Where, 

In the first case:

The number of women employed = M1 

The time is taken to complete the work = D₁ days

In the second case:

The number of women employed = M2

The time is taken to complete the work = D2 days

**Calculation:**

In the first case:

The number of women employed, M₁ = N

The time is taken to complete the work, D₁ = 12 days

In the second case:

The number of women employed, M2 = N - 5

The time is taken to complete the work, D2 = 12 + 15 = 27 days

Now, 

⇒ M₁D₁ = M2D2 

⇒ (N × 12) = (N - 5) × 27

⇒ 12N = 27N - 135

⇒ 15N = 135

⇒ N = 9

**∴ The initial number of women employed is 9.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

N women can complete the project in T days. If M women are more employed then it will take d less days to complete the same project,

Then the number of women initially employed = N = (M times (T - d))/(d)
